content: Anọng p'Ibinọkpaabyi otzek

K'ogbe kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, ótzima bọng odim k'irerek nnuma, kẹ okhubh idibhon khaabhada, kw'ode anọng pa Hit, ọmaana anọng pa Girgash, ọmaana anọng p'Amọr, ọmaana anọng pa Kenan, ọmaana anọng pa Pẹriz, ọmaana anọng pa Hiv, ttara anọng pa Jẹbus, kw'ode idibhon izenamfa s'ibar-ọbar, ibiri ikhaama ẹfa iyọhnga bọng.

Idikha Ọvaar Ibinọkpabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, okk'ibhon nna ọtzọkha okhe bọng ka mbọhk, bọng akhema bẹ, bọng fhu bẹ biphyir. Bọng echekhi kpenamkpen kàsi ọmaana anọng mba, bọng bẹ nkwo kàbira are.
Bọng bẹ k'ọbada kàtzọkha, bọng aminava pabọng kàtzọkha anang ajinọng pabẹ k'ọbada, bọng aminava pabẹ kàtzọkha anang ajinọng pabọng k'ọbada,
oni mando ode, bẹ ábhakhi nttem sa va pabọng ọbhakhi, bẹ kaam dọk kakpobha, da bẹ an-akpobha ikha. Mẹ wọ osi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọ́dọkhi ettem ttara bọng, óbiri ódimi bọng ẹbhar-ẹbhar.
Ma wọ ode odik kwa bọng ási bẹ: bọng vọhkhi ọja-fọhnibe fabẹ, ọmaana ndur sabẹ, bọng abira avọhkhi mkpọmmachi s'Ashẹra pabẹ. Bọng kwọmi agbatza pabẹ k'ekpon.

Da bọng ade anọng p'awur-owur p'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng okk'bọng otzekha k'ottem kw'anọngẹya m'itzitzikha s'ọyagbin bi, bọng ade anọng pẹ p'ohokhi ettem.

Kode bi da iwa bọng ahaabhi ayọhnga idibhon idọdọk wọ osi, yina iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkhaama idadaakha ọmaana bọng, obiro otzekha bọng, okhuribi bọbọng bọ akhar ọtzam ayọhnga idibhon biphyir.

Yina, wa ofon k'idadakha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkhaam ọmaana bọng, ọmaana da iwa obiro ohok echekhi ch'ọkhaam ọmaana ab'atte, wa otzima ọbọhk kwẹ kw'ẹfa obhek bọng k'irerek s'ebira, ka mbọhk sa Phẹro kw'ode ọvaarnọng kw'Ijip.

Bọng nonga bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, wọ ode Ibinọkpaabyi. Kẹ wọ ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'oni ottotto ọkhaam, kw'om-ohok ch'echekhi chẹ ch'idadaakha s'ọkhaam maa, opyiri nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh jobh maa, ayong-oyongi, kw'anọng p'akhaam idadaakha ttara kẹ, bẹ abira ahok asana pẹ.
Yina,

content.text: kẹ ogbe kokhibhi bi, ochora anọng mbuma p'attaang-ẹ.

content: Mẹ wọ osi, bọng dọkha ogbe ahok asana, ọmaana akpebhi, ttara aphaangi pa nnangi bọng, mayina.

Idikha bọng átzọhkha ogbe áyonga itzọhng, ahok aphaangi mba, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng ohok echekhi ch'idadaakha s'ọkhaam ttara bọng, mach’iwa okk'ochekhi ọnang ab'atte pabọng.

Kẹ ọ́khaama idadakha ọ́khaama ọmaana bọng, óbiro ódo bọng, obiro ọttara bọng ọhaabh. Kẹ ódo va pabọng, ọmaana ekpo pya bọng ayaabh mach'abọkpa, ọmaana atzuk abhapẹ ttara ana p'oliv. Ọ́ttara obhik k'abhaam ọmaana k'arukhimaan pabọng, k'irerek s'iwa ochekhi ọnang ab'atte bi, ọnang bọng.
Ójibh bọng ọyọhnga idibhon kpenamkpen, ọnọng manda wani k'ottem kwa va pabọng, ode ojinọng obiro ode kwanọng kw'oni nnwa ọkhaama kóde. Otzirattọhk manda vani f'oni ọmaan osi kóde.

Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkpa ọkhọmana kpenamkpen eden f'ira ọmma bọng. Akhọmana-tzama pa bọng arong k'Ijip, ọbọhk kótte bẹ amma bọng. Yina, kẹ otte ikhọmana nna ọbọhk imma attattaanganọng pabọng.

Bọng akhaambi adimi idibhon kpenamkpen s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, ọtzọkha okhe bọng ka mbọhk. Bọng bẹ nkwo kàre, bọng ikha sabẹ kàbira akpobha, kkeri sẹ íde agbagbara inang bọng.
Bọng afha achibhi bi, “Idibhon nna igaangi iyọhnga man, ma yan kwa morenga okhubh sẹ?”
Yina, tte anọng p'idibhon aningi bọng ajor; bọng jima odik kw'iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpabyi kwabọng, osi Phẹro ọmaana anọng p'Ijip biphyir.

Wa bọng akk'chen atzima are nyoma-barada, ọmaana ngọhkha, ọmaana ikkokkonidik, ọmaana ẹfa ch'odimbọhk ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, otzim ọkkaana bọng. Mando kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, óbiro ósi anọng mba p'am-ajora bọng.
Ayongi mẹ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, ọ́tzima abhingiho ofhu bẹ maa, ore bi ayok p'iwa arọbhi bọng achubha, akk'apa.
Tte bẹ aningi bọng ajor, kkeri Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, kw'owobh ttara bọng, ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ọbar-ọbar, obiro ojor-ojora.

Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, ófhumi-etzen ókhubh idibhon nna okhubh ka bọng k'ottem. Bọng ọbọhk k'otte bi, bọng akhubh bẹ eden dani, oni mando ode nkkakkama-tzen ḿmaan k'ohaabh ngọri bọng.
Yina, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng, ọtzọkha bẹ ọtzọkha okhe bọng ka mbọhk, ọbhari bẹ ka damadama kw'ideden maa, bọng afhu bẹ biphyir.
Kẹ ọ́tzọkha avaarnọng pabẹ okhe bọng ka mbọhk, bọng ábira ádimi che pabẹ m'ọyagbin. Ọnọng kw'ọfha obe bọng abẹ kóde, bọng ádimi bẹ odimi.

Bọng kwọmi agbatza p'ikha sabẹ k'ekpon. Bọng asilva ọmaana gol pabẹ katzọkha akhaama, ifha bẹ aningi agbagbara ade anang bọng, da ekpo mbya ekpukhi Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwabọng ekpukhi.

Bọng agbatza p'ikha nna kàtzima akwu k'ihọhm sabọng. Oni mando ode, bọng an-owobha k'ekhibhi, macha bẹ awobh. Bọng nne pyẹ mach'ekpo pya bọng attaang-ọttaanga, ebere ekpukhi bọng okpukhi, da bẹ akk'pyẹ atzekha ahok k'ekhibhi.
